evidence.text: Maintained the Kotlin service that sequences stops for 1,100 van routes each morning across 14 depots
evidence.notes: Directly states maintenance of a Kotlin route-planning service

evidence.text: Added a postcode-validation step to the address import that quarantines records failing the national address file lookup for manual review and produces a daily exception list for the depot teams
evidence.notes: Shows integration of address data with validation

evidence.text: Released the delivery time-window constraint to the live route planner on 6 June 2023 under change ticket OPS-3318, deploying in the 02:00 maintenance window and watching the first three morning planning runs with the depot leads
evidence.notes: Demonstrates release to live system and monitoring

evidence.text: Work sample: the release record for OPS-3318, containing the change-board approval, the deployment log from the 02:00 window, the checklist for the three monitored planning runs and a short incident note about one depot whose routes were rebuilt by hand on the first morning
Covered the depot-support rota one week in four from 2022, answering planners' questions and fixing failed route builds before dispatch, and writing a short note in the rota log after each shift
evidence.notes: Shows participation in operational support rota

evidence.text: Compared planned route length for the four weeks before and after the time-window change, using the planner's own output files; the comparison was shared with the depot operations manager
